title.rendered: Board of Directors Work Session – February 17, 2021

content.rendered:
The Sherwood School District Board of Directors will meet in a Special Work Session on Wednesday, February 17, 2021, at 6:00pm, on the topic of reopening updates for the secondary level. To access a livestream video of this meeting, please visit the District’s YouTube channel at https://bit.ly/39VlhD3

The agenda for this meeting can be viewed here.
